# Version 4.148.0
> **First stable v4 release** · Released June 22, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.148.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.148.0)

> **Supersedes [4.147.0](4.147.0.md)** · Rolls up preview-only work that was never released as stable — those changes are included cumulatively below.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.148.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m148 with variable fonts and animated WebP. This release rolls up everything from the 4.147.x preview line: Skia m148, variable font and color palette support, animated WebP encoding, new stream and surface APIs, and a completely reworked singleton lifecycle. It is a breaking release — review the changes below before upgrading from v3.

## Breaking Changes

- **SKPaint text/font members promoted to compile errors** — Legacy SKPaint text and font members that were deprecated in v3 now emit compile errors. Move typeface selection and text-size configuration onto SKFont instead. ([#4068](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4068), [#4205](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4205))
- **Remaining pre-v4 obsolete APIs promoted to compile errors** — Any pre-v4 obsoleted members not already covered above now fail to compile. Check your build output and follow the migration hints in each diagnostic. ([#4195](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4195))
- **new SKFont() now uses an empty typeface** — Upstream m132 removed lazy default-typeface resolution. new SKFont() now stores SKTypeface.Empty instead of resolving the platform default at draw time, so MeasureText returns 0 and nothing is drawn unless you pass an explicit typeface. Migrate: new SKFont(SKTypeface.Default). Detect unset with font.Typeface.IsEmpty instead of == null.
- **new SKPaint().Typeface returns Default instead of null** — SKPaint now seeds its font with SKTypeface.Default on construction and after Reset(), so paint.Typeface is never null. Code that checked paint.Typeface == null to detect no typeface set will no longer fire; use paint.Typeface.IsEmpty instead.
- **SKTypeface.FromFamilyName now returns Default (not null) for missing families on Android** — The per-platform legacy lookup path that returned null on Android for unknown families has been replaced by a consistent font-manager lookup. FromFamilyName is now never null on any platform. Use SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily(name) if you need strict null-on-miss semantics.
- **SKStream.Move(long) now throws OverflowException and is obsolete** — The native offset is a 32-bit int. The long overload now uses a checked cast and is marked [Obsolete]. Large out-of-range offsets now throw instead of silently truncating. Migrate: call Move(int) with a validated in-range offset.
- **GRContext.CreateVulkan aborts on Vulkan 1.0 instead of returning null** — Ganesh now requires Vulkan 1.1. On a Vulkan 1.0 instance or device the process terminates via SK_ABORT — this is not a catchable exception. Declare VK_API_VERSION_1_1 in your VkApplicationInfo.apiVersion AND set GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion to the same value. Devices that only support Vulkan 1.0 must use the raster or another non-Ganesh backend.
- **GRVkBackendContextNative: five fields removed** — fMinAPIVersion, fInstanceVersion, fExtensions, fFeatures, and fOwnsInstanceAndDevice have been removed from GRVkBackendContextNative. Replace fExtensions with fVkExtensions and fFeatures with fDeviceFeatures / fDeviceFeatures2. Remove the other three assignments.
- **GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo retype and GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo loses value-equality** — GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo is now typed GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo (was GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo). The old struct no longer implements IEquatable or equality operators. Update any == / != comparisons or Equals calls to use the new type.
- **SKNativeObject.IgnorePublicDispose setter removed** — The protected setter for IgnorePublicDispose has been removed. Subclasses that set this property must migrate to the constructor parameter or another lifecycle mechanism.

## Engine

- **Skia upgraded through milestones m132 → m147 → m148** — The bundled engine progresses from the v3 Skia pin all the way to chrome/m148, incorporating over a year of upstream rendering fixes, performance improvements, and backend updates. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3560](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3560), [#3660](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3660), [#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702), [#4125](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4125))

## API Surface

- **Variable font and color palette support** — SKTypeface gains variable-font axis enumeration and coordinate APIs, and a new SKFontStyleSet enables palette iteration. HarfBuzzSharp receives matching variable-font support. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3703](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3703), [#3742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3742))
- **Animated WebP encoding (SKWebpEncoder)** — A new SKWebpEncoder class supports encoding multi-frame animated WebP streams directly from SkiaSharp. ([#3771](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3771))
- **SKStream.GetData() for zero-copy stream-to-data access** — A new GetData() method returns the underlying data of a seekable stream as SKData without copying, enabling zero-copy workflows for in-memory streams. ([#3772](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3772))
- **SKSamplingOptions support for SKSurface.Draw and SKCanvas.DrawSurface** — DrawSurface and the surface Draw overloads now accept SKSamplingOptions, giving callers control over filtering quality when compositing surfaces. ([#3491](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3491))
- **HarfBuzz API completeness and HBColor struct** — Missing HarfBuzz API wrappers were added, naming-convention violations fixed, and a new HBColor struct properly represents hb_color_t values in managed code. ([#4000](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4000), [#4001](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4001))
- **Linux Bionic native assets** — SkiaSharp now ships native assets for Linux Bionic (Android-style libc), enabling Android-NDK-linked Linux environments. — ❤️ [@4Darmygeometry](https://github.com/4Darmygeometry) ([#3217](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3217))
- **Tizen x64 and arm64 native build support** — Native Tizen builds are now produced for both x64 and arm64 architectures. ([#3620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3620))

## Bug Fixes

- **SKPixmap/SKBitmap GetPixelSpan stride and offset corrections** — GetPixelSpan now uses RowBytes for stride (not Width * bytesPerPixel), and the GetPixelSpan<T>(x, y) overload was using Height instead of Width for the offset calculation — both are now fixed. ([#4148](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4148), [#4128](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4128))
- **SKPath finalizer crash when SKPathBuilder is collected first** — A race condition between SKPath and its builder during GC finalization caused a native crash. The finalizer ordering is now safe. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3796](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3796))
- **Default typeface resolution on Android API 36+** — A null-dereference on Android API 36+ when the font manager returned null for the default typeface is fixed; the fallback now yields SKTypeface.Empty instead of crashing. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3730))
- **WinUI Projection DLL not found for .NET 9 consumers** — The WinUI native projection DLL was not being located correctly for .NET 9 consumers. The asset resolution is now correct. ([#4084](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4084))
- **Android SKGLView not rendering after tab switch in MAUI TabBar** — SKGLView on Android lost its rendering surface when the containing MAUI TabBar tab was switched and then restored. The surface is now recreated correctly. — ❤️ [@SimonvBez](https://github.com/SimonvBez) ([#3076](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3076))
- **Apple platform TFMs corrected** — Library TFMs now use versioned targets (e.g. ios26.0) and application TFMs use unversioned forms, matching the Apple platform conventions and fixing downstream build warnings. ([#3798](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3798))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Singleton lifecycle reworked** — The lifecycle of singleton instances (SKTypeface.Default, SKColorSpace.Srgb, and similar cached singletons) has been redesigned to avoid finalizer-ordering issues and to be safe across AppDomain unload and process teardown. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4080))
- **Native-compat gate moved from ModuleInitializer to SkiaApi constructor** — The runtime check that guards against loading an incompatible native library now runs in the SkiaApi static constructor instead of a module initializer, avoiding initialization-order edge cases. ([#4133](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4133))
- **WASM: pre-.NET 8 Emscripten builds dropped** — Native WASM builds for Emscripten versions prior to .NET 8 are no longer produced, reducing build surface. ([#4022](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4022))

## Platform

- **Linux Docker builds migrated to .NET official cross-compilation images** — Linux native build containers now use the .NET team's official cross-compilation Docker images, ensuring consistent toolchains and faster build setup. ([#4062](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4062))

## Security

- **Native dependency refreshes: expat, libjpeg-turbo, freetype, zlib, libpng, libexpat, HarfBuzz** — expat updated to 2.8.1, libjpeg-turbo to 3.1.4.1, freetype to 2.14.3, zlib to 1.3.2.1-motley, libpng to 1.6.58, libexpat to 2.7.5, and HarfBuzz to 14.2.0. ([#4079](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4079), [#4012](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4012), [#3726](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3726), [#3720](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3720), [#3718](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3718), [#3717](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3717), [#4035](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4035))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0

HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0 ships with this release, adding variable font axis support, a new HBColor struct, missing API wrappers, and the 14.2.0 upstream update.

RC 1 landed the Skia m148 engine upgrade, SKPixmap GetPixelSpan fixes, the remaining v4 obsolete promotions to compile errors, the singleton lifecycle rework, WinUI .NET 9 fix, expat 2.8.1, and HarfBuzz 14.2.0.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.147.0-preview.3.1...v4.148.0-rc.1.2)

Preview 3 added libjpeg-turbo 3.1.4.1, freetype 2.14.3, zlib and libpng/libexpat security updates, the HarfBuzz HBColor struct and missing API wrappers, and dropped pre-.NET 8 WASM builds.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.147.0-preview.2.1...v4.147.0-preview.3.1)

Preview 1 opened the v4 line with Skia milestones m132 through m147, variable fonts and color palette APIs, SKSamplingOptions for surface drawing, Linux Bionic assets, Tizen x64/arm64 builds, and the Android tab-switch rendering fix.
